I1.quote: Eleven participants have reported isotherm curves at liquid nitrogen temperature (77 K): six by static volumetry, four by static gravimetry, and one by dynamic volumetry.

I2.quote: A commercial microporous carbon molecular sieve from Takeda Chem. Ind. Japan (CMS 4A) has been selected as RRT material.

I3.quote: The maximum hydrogen adsorbed is 1.4 wt.% at 77 K and 1 MPa

I4.quote: From the linear regression of the BET plot a value of 423 (±20) m2/g was obtained for the surface area.

I5.quote: A Round Robin exercise has been carried out in the frame of the European project NESSHY (Novel and Efficient Solid State HYdrogen storage systems) to evaluate the hydrogen physisorption on a commercial microporous carbon material.

notes: Multi-laboratory Round Robin Test: fourteen laboratories measured H2 isotherms on one commercial carbon molecular sieve (Takeda CMS 4A) at 77 K and ambient temperature by static volumetric, static gravimetric and dynamic volumetric methods; interpolated uptake values at fixed pressures are tabulated in SI Tables 1 and 3. BET area (N2, 77 K) measured by the organisers on the RRT material. The paper cites one earlier published value for CMS 4A (ref. 25, 1.45 wt.% at 77 K and 2 MPa) but does not state that its own RRT uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Not a review: original data.
